_help: remote_path is filled in on the first /deploy after SSH DELUXE confirms the web root. The server pulls the GitHub repo every 15 minutes (deploy/server-pull.sh, set up with deploy/SERVER-SETUP.md). Never store hosts, passwords or keys here; SSH DELUXE holds the connection.
dns: GoDaddy (domaincontrol.com); change only the @ A record, keep MX/TXT/www
cpanel_note: Addon domain on a shared cPanel account; the account's primary domain is a different site. The repo clone lives at ~/hscfdoral-repo (outside public_html).
